items.name: Alisa
items.text: Booked the Buba cart for my birthday and WOW — best idea ever! The drinks were amazing, the baristas were great, and everything ran out in literally 30 minutes flat. That's how good it was 😄 Should have ordered double the amount! Super smooth experience from start to finish. Will definitely book again for my next event. Highly recommend!

items.name: Shanon
items.text: We booked catering for my daughter's birthday party and it was such a great decision! The whole experience felt effortless — the baristas arrived on time, set everything up beautifully, and took care of all the guests with such warmth. What I loved most as a mom was knowing that the drinks are made from real, natural ingredients. No worries about what the kids were having — everyone could enjoy without a second thought. The vibe it created at the party was just perfect. Guests were happy, kids were happy, and I could actually relax and enjoy the celebration instead of stressing about the drinks. We will absolutely book again! ☕🎂🎉

items.name: Ketut
items.text: Booked Buba catering for our wedding and it was absolutely magical. We worked with the team to recreate a custom drink — the one we had on our very first date. They nailed it completely. The cart itself was so beautiful and photogenic that it blended into our decor like it was always meant to be there. Honestly one of the most Instagrammable moments of the whole wedding. Professional, creative, and genuinely thoughtful service. Cannot recommend enough for anyone planning a wedding in Bali! 💍☕

items.name: Ayu
items.text: Ordered the catering for our Gigradar padel tournament — outdoor, midday, Bali heat. The Buba team saved the day. Fresh drinks on demand, friendly baristas, and a setup that looked amazing in the sun. The whole team loved it. Nothing beats an ice cold drink between matches when it's 35 degrees outside. Professional service, zero stress to organize. 10/10 would book again!
